description: Defines an abstract base class for loan repayment business events within the Fineract project, extending the general business event class and associating it with loan repayment schedule installments.

classes.name: LoanRepaymentBusinessEvent
classes.description: Abstract class for loan repayment business events associated with a specific loan repayment schedule installment.

methods.name: LoanRepaymentBusinessEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with a specific loan repayment schedule installment.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the event, which is 'Loan'.

methods.name: getAggregateRootId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the loan associated with the repayment installment.
